requestId.description: Caller-generated unique id, safe for directory names (last char alphanumeric; Windows reserved device names are rejected by the bridge). Recommended: <yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ>-<8 hex>.

promptFile.description: Path to the UTF-8 Markdown prompt. Relative paths resolve against the request.json directory.

attachments.description: 1.1 (A-068): files to attach via the composer file input. Relative paths resolve against the request.json directory. Secret-looking names/contents are refused before the browser starts.

preset.description: Effort slider level (5 levels). current = do not touch, observe and reverse-map the label.

model.description: 1.1 (A-067): model radio in the picker. Optional; current = observe only. preset remains the effort slider level.

newChat.description: true: open a new chat. false (1.2, A-096): continue the conversation at conversationUrl; the latest assistant turn after submit is extracted.

conversationUrl.description: 1.2: required when newChat is false. Taken from a previous result.json.

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound from submit to completion. Optional; the bridge applies 900000 when omitted (A-030).
